all_candidates.topic: Should university admissions prioritize board marks over entrance exams?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Nationwide student protests over the NEET paper leaks (last 7 days) highlighted discontent with high-stakes entrance examinations.

all_candidates.topic: Is the recent milk price hike in Maharashtra justified?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Milk prices in Maharashtra increased by Rs 2 per litre, effective August 9, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should Indian companies be restricted from AI-driven layoffs?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Oracle cut around 12,000 roles in India in 2026 due to AI adoption, as reported on August 2, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should strict noise pollution laws apply to religious processions?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A video of a motorcycle with '100 horns' seized during Kanwar Yatra went viral on August 8, 2026, sparking debate on noise pollution.

all_candidates.topic: Has Gen Z's protest style changed India's political discourse for the better?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The 'Cockroach Janta Party' led youth protests over NEET (August 3-5, 2026) using social media, sparking debates on dissent and media.

all_candidates.topic: Is AI creating enough new jobs to offset those it displaces?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A Nomura report released August 8, 2026, stated India recorded more AI-related hires than layoffs from 2022-August 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should social media platforms be liable for viral misinformation?
all_candidates.news_anchor: An Indian-origin woman in Texas was falsely accused of visa fraud in a viral X post on August 6, 2026, sparking debate on online misinformation.

all_candidates.topic: Should India's new exam reforms effectively prevent future leaks?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India unveiled sweeping exam reforms and formed a task force after the NEET-UG paper leak scandal, effective August 6, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Will the new exam reform task force effectively rebuild trust?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Prime Minister Modi announced a high-powered task force on August 6, 2026, to recommend structural reforms for India's examination system.

all_candidates.topic: Will higher windfall tax on fuel exports stabilize domestic prices?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Indian government increased windfall tax on petrol, diesel, and ATF exports, effective August 3, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Do new Tatkal booking rules improve train ticket access?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Indian Railways revised its Tatkal Ticket booking rules and procedures, effective from August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should all major Indian cities adopt Delhi's new EV policy?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Delhi EV Policy, prioritizing electrification and offering incentives, was announced on August 6, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should wholesale energy price surges be directly passed to consumers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) surged in May-June 2026, with petroleum and natural gas prices up 61.51% in May, as reported on August 3, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Are AI professionals in India overly concerned about future job security?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A Blind survey released August 7, 2026, found 66% of AI/ML professionals in India expect job cuts in the next 3-6 months.

all_candidates.topic: Can AI significantly improve public bus transport across India?
all_candidates.news_anchor: AI emerged as a key focus for future-ready bus transport at the UITP India Bus Conference 2026, which concluded on August 7, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Are new credit card reward policies beneficial for average consumers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: New banking guidelines, including restructured credit card reward policies, became effective from August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should India mandate Unified Metropolitan Transport Authorities nationwide?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Experts at the Business Today Infrastructure Summit 2026 (July 31, 2026) highlighted the urgent need for comprehensive metropolitan transport authorities.

all_candidates.topic: Is mandatory 'Ship-to GSTIN' good for business compliance?
all_candidates.news_anchor: GSTN's changes to e-Invoice and e-Way Bill systems, making 'Ship-to GSTIN' mandatory, became effective from August 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Will the MSMED Amendment Bill significantly boost small businesses?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (Amendment) Bill, 2026, was passed by Parliament between August 3 and 7, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Will new tax exemptions effectively attract more offshore funds to India?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, proposing tax rule changes to attract offshore funds, was introduced in Lok Sabha on August 4, 2026.
